room_rent.display: Any room up to SI (except Suite+)
room_rent.note: Gold variant baseline: room rent covered up to SI except Suite or above category; pro-rata if higher than eligible. Silver variant has tighter limits

icu.note: ICU charges covered under inpatient up to SI

copayment.note: Co-pay optional (10%/20%). Zone-2 metro 20% co-pay applies for Silver/Gold if Zone 2 chosen; Platinum has no zone co-pay. VERIFY chosen zone

sub_limits.note: Modern treatments covered up to SI with ₹50,000 sub-limit on a few conditions

initial_waiting.note: 30-day standard initial illness waiting; some illness exclusions reference 90 days from first policy. VERIFY exact initial waiting

ped_waiting.note: 24 months under Gold & Platinum; 36 months under Silver plan

maternity.note: Maternity benefit covered up to 2 pregnancies/terminations; 24 months continuous coverage required; new-born baby cover included

cumulative_bonus.note: Cumulative Bonus / Loyalty Additions: +10% of expiring Base SI per policy year, max 100% of Base SI

restoration.note: Re-fill reinstates up to 100% Base SI once per policy year, applicable for same and different illness; floater basis

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment in AYUSH hospital up to SI

ambulance.note: Emergency road ambulance; non-network up to ₹2,000 per event; network up to SI. VERIFY

modern_treatments.note: Up to SI; ₹50,000 sub-limit on a few conditions

consumables.note: Allowable consumables listed under inpatient charges

grace_period.note: VERIFY exact grace; 15 days for instalment mode

notable_exclusions.display: Multi-variant (Silver/Gold/Platinum); HIV/AIDS 4yr & mental disorder 3yr waiting; Zone-2 metro co-pay for Silver/Gold

optional_riders.display: Hospital Cash, Personal Accident (up to 5x SI, max ₹1Cr), Critical Illness (up to ₹10L), premium waiver, co-pay options, e-consultation
